description: Use this when the user wants to change how their sessions sound or are chosen: a voice, a language, a length, the music layer on or off, or Quiet mode. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

language.description: Audio language as a BCP-47 code (en, es, pt-BR, fr, it, ja, hi, ko, hu, or any other such as pl). Always pass the language the user writes in. If the language is not available the answer says so and gives the closest live one. hi, ko and hu are beta.

music.description: The music layer on or off.

quiet_mode.description: Quiet mode hides badges and progress.

tap.description: The token from keep_progress for this conversation; leave empty if there is none.

voice_id.description: A voice id as returned by find_sessions.

name: set_preferences
title: Change my settings
